name: tool-ask-user
title: Questions: your agent asks you, with buttons or a form where the chat draws them (the askUser tool)
description: The `askUser` tool, for the agents that name it: one question (yes or no, a choice, several, text, a date) that ends the run, drawn as buttons or a form by a channel that can (Google Chat) and sent as text by any other; the answer comes back as a message.
